title: Business English Conversation 40:  No Personal Life
content: 1. a personal life: one's life not related to one's work or career - She is a workaholic. She doesn't have a personal life. - My manager never talks about his personal life. 2. to balance things: to do or focus on multiple things equally - We need to balance our work life and our personal life. - It is hard to balance raising kids and having a career. 3. to set a strict schedule: to make a schedule that is not flexible - We need to set a strict schedule and then stick to it. - I prefer to set a flexible schedule than to set a strict schedule.
